Features

What makes KiwiOS different

Every piece of the desktop built deliberately, not assembled from defaults.

Custom Wayland compositor

Built on wlroots. Every interaction defined by us, not inherited from an existing desktop.

Koa AI assistant

Powered by Gemini. Knows battery, WiFi, time — opens apps on a text command.

Runs on anything

Lightweight by design. Performs well on modest hardware.

Real apps out of the box

Firefox, file manager, terminal — running natively inside the compositor.

Wayland native

Modern, secure display protocol. No X11 legacy overhead.

Debian base

Stable Linux foundations. Thousands of packages via apt.

Smart dock

Floating dock with battery, WiFi, Bluetooth, and live clock.

Botanical desktop

Warm, nature-inspired wallpaper designed specifically for KiwiOS.
